tests.prompt: Export the variables from our Figma file (https://www.figma.com/design/AbC123/Brand-Library) into Tailwind v4 and CSS for our Next.js app. We have Light and Dark modes.
tests.good: Parses the file key; notes get_variable_defs is default-mode only and the REST Variables API is Enterprise-only; runs read-variables.js via use_figma (read-only), then convert-tokens.mjs to tailwind-v4 and css-vars with both modes; reports converter warnings; normalises opacity 0-100 to 0-1 and rounds float noise; keeps semantic tokens as var() references with a dark block; checks text/background contrast in both modes; lands it as a reviewable diff, never hand-editing generated files; states who owns the tokens.

tests.prompt: Write a screen reader spec for our text field component (label, input, helper text, error message, and a clear button that appears when there's text).
tests.good: Runs a merge analysis first: label, helper and error merge into the input; clear button is a conditional second stop; error is a live region, not a stop. Gives a focus order section, collapses states with identical semantics, keeps error and disabled separate, and provides VoiceOver, TalkBack and ARIA tables per stop (label/value/traits/hint; content/role/state; native input with label, aria-describedby, aria-invalid) each with Do NOT rows (no double-read label, placeholder not the name, clear icon labelled). States the disabled policy.

tests.prompt: Audit our Figma component library against the React components in packages/ui and tell me what's out of sync. Then fix it.
tests.good: Agrees scope and files and respects the seat's call limits; runs lint-design.js (design-system and wcag rules) per page and check-parity.js with a CODE_SPEC per key component; searches code for raw colours and arbitrary values; reports findings with node ids or file paths, severity and fix, grouped by root cause, with a parity score and probable renames; proposes fixes and asks before any Figma write or library publish; re-runs checks and shows before and after.

tests.prompt: Turn the checkout frame in our Figma file (https://www.figma.com/design/XyZ789/Checkout?node-id=12-34) into React components in our Next.js + shadcn/ui app, using our existing tokens. Add tests that catch it when the build drifts from the design.
tests.good: States a short plan first: the bridge here (figma-mcp.md: get_metadata, then targeted reads; token-sync-and-drift.md; design-to-code.md: reuse existing components and map every value to a token, gaps listed), the build through frontend-ui-design (components-and-states.md and react-shadcn-tailwind.md: every field and button state, including loading, error and disabled), the tests through testing-qa (playwright-e2e.md: toHaveScreenshot at a fixed viewport with dynamic regions masked, role-based locators for the pay flow). Runs check-parity.js on key components; compares renders at mobile and desktop; checks the Done means of all three crafts and says what wasn't verified.
